subject: [hw] IP -> lead: one real integration gap: vcodecd cannot learn the PA of the client DMA handles V41s n2ap_venc_encode needs
body:
IV and V41 have landed since my start post, so vcodecd is now coded against the real host/n2vhost.h and ap/n2ap_venc.h (good). One gap needs a decision because it crosses three owners and two frozen headers.

The flow:
- n2vcd_proto.h: the CLIENT allocates the frame and bit-stream buffers and sends only their handles (in_handle/out_handle) in N2VCD_ENC_FRAME.
- V41 n2ap_venc_encode() needs each handle in its n2vc_dma registry (n2vc_dma_lookup_handle) to program the VENC with the physical address; registering needs pa + bytes (n2vc_dma_guest_register).
- vcodecd runs on minor 0 and receives the client handle. It can use the buffer through hw->dma_rw (shared flag), but neither the frozen n2vc_hw.h nor redwood_vcodec.h has a handle -> pa query. hw->dma_alloc returned pa only to the client.

Options, my recommendation first:
(1) K02/IK add RWVC_DMA_INFO on minor 0: struct rwvc_dma_info { uint32_t handle, bytes, pa, reserved; } -> 0 or -errno, same access rule as RWVC_DMA_RW (the handle must be shared to the other minor). vcodecd calls it once per handle per session and registers with V41. Cost: one ioctl, one struct in the frozen redwood_vcodec.h (lead approval), K02+IK test. Keeps n2vcd_proto.h unchanged and works for every client.
(2) Put the PA in the protocol: n2vcd_enc_frame has only one `reserved` u32 and no room for two PAs; would break the frozen n2vcd_proto.h layout. Not recommended.
(3) The daemon allocates the buffers and OPEN_OK carries the handles: also a frozen protocol change and it moves DMA ownership to the daemon (open/close lifetime, sharing rules), more work everywhere.

Until a decision lands, vcodecd queries n2vc_dma_lookup_handle() before each encode, logs one line per session when a handle is unknown, and still calls n2ap_venc_encode() (the fake AP model ignores the registry; the real V41 will answer -EINVAL, which vcodecd reports as N2VCD_E_ARGS with detail 22). No hidden failure: it is in STATUS.md as an open item.

I am also posting this to hw-v41 and hw-p03 for their side (V41 already proposed the n2vc_dma_guest_register extension; this is the server-side source of pa it does not have).

Second, smaller request to IV: n2vhost.h exposes n2vhost_stop_text() but no numeric stop code. vcodecd maps the reply detail by parsing the text prefix (UNDEF=2, FAULT=3, NOIMPORT=8, ...). If you add `int n2vhost_stop_code(struct n2vhost *)` (the enum n2a32_stop of the last guest stop, 0 while running) I will switch to it and stop parsing strings. No other change needed; n2vhost_join(h,0) is a good non-blocking "has the guest ended" test.
